summary: Completed deep frontend rollback verification for CareerPeek V1 career library using static code comparison and live desktop/mobile route-flow testing. Rollback behavior passed for five kept careers and 54 removed careers.
critical_code_review_comments: App.css is byte-identical to pre-change snapshot.
careersDb currently contains only the original five in expected order: nurse, software-developer, doctor, chartered-accountant, entrepreneur.
careerContent contains only the original five keys and each object is deep-equal to /tmp/careerpeek-library-before/careerContent.js for those five careers.
No expansion-only slug routes, search results, or active links were found in src/public/build when checked using exact slug/route patterns.
No backend/API integration exists; frontend remains static data by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated live URL from frontend/.env only. Executed broad regression: Home -> Let's Start -> Careers (exact five cards/order), search behavior incl. case/partial/whitespace, 54 removed full-name negative searches, full detail+roadmap+salary+first-hand+LinkedIn flow for each of five careers, browser back/forward checks, direct removed-slug and removed-slug/roadmap fallback behavior for all 54, representative trailing slash/query/hash/unknown/constructor/__proto__/toString variants, mobile 390x844 overflow and per-career usability pass. No runtime console/page errors observed.
rca of the issue: One initial script run flagged detail->roadmap scroll restoration at Nurse due an early timing assertion. Re-ran full suite with stabilized waits and explicit route/section checks; issue not reproducible. Classified as test-timing false signal, not confirmed app bug.
